description: Checks the ports this project's dev server should use (read from its config, or framework defaults) and reports which are listening, the process holding each, and whether that process belongs to this project. Use this to confirm a port conflict or check whether the dev server came back up after a restart, without rerunning the full snapshot.

cwd.description: Absolute path to the project root. Optional: defaults to the client's workspace root, or the server's working directory.

name: get_running_services
title: Dev server ports
